company.name: Harborwick 3PL Ltd.
company.summary: Fictional 3PL/distribution warehouse: 6,000 m2, about 40 staff, two shifts, six zones A-F, electric MHE fleet.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Forklifts must not exceed 10 km/h inside the building.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Forklifts must not exceed 15 km/h in the outdoor yard.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Forklifts must slow to 5 km/h in marked pedestrian zones and crossings.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Forklifts must not exceed 5 km/h on dock ramps and leveller approaches.

facts.subject: pallet_stack
facts.statement: Free block-stacked pallets must not exceed 4.0 m in height.

facts.subject: pallet_stack
facts.statement: Free block-stacked pallets must not exceed 3 pallets high.

facts.subject: rack_bay
facts.statement: Each rack bay may carry at most 2,700 kg.

facts.subject: cold_zone
facts.statement: The cold zone must stay at or above +2 °C.

facts.subject: cold_zone
facts.statement: The cold zone must stay at or below +8 °C.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: No more than 4,000 kg of hazmat may be stored in the hazmat cage at one time.

facts.subject: main_aisle
facts.statement: Main transport aisles are 4.0 m wide.

facts.subject: storage_aisle
facts.statement: Rack storage aisles are 3.0 m wide.

facts.subject: pedestrian_walkway
facts.statement: Segregated pedestrian walkways are 1.2 m wide.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: Damaged-goods write-offs above 500 EUR need warehouse-manager approval.

facts.subject: zone_a
facts.statement: Zone A is the receiving zone: inbound docks 1-4, unloading and goods inspection.

facts.subject: zone_b
facts.statement: Zone B is the bulk storage zone: high-bay pallet racking.

facts.subject: zone_c
facts.statement: Zone C is the picking zone: ground-level pick faces and flow racks.

facts.subject: zone_d
facts.statement: Zone D is the dispatch zone: outbound staging in front of docks 5-8.

facts.subject: zone_e
facts.statement: Zone E is the cold zone: chilled storage held at +2 to +8 °C.

facts.subject: zone_f
facts.statement: Zone F holds the value-added services area.

facts.subject: warehouse
facts.statement: The warehouse floor covers 6,000 m2.

facts.subject: racking
facts.statement: The high-bay racking provides 2,400 pallet positions.

facts.subject: docks
facts.statement: The building has 8 dock doors.

facts.subject: docks
facts.statement: Dock doors 1-4 serve inbound receiving.

facts.subject: docks
facts.statement: Dock doors 5-8 serve outbound dispatch.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: The hazmat cage inside Zone F covers 60 m2.

facts.subject: quarantine_area
facts.statement: The quarantine area is in Zone F.

facts.subject: returns_inspection
facts.statement: Returns are inspected in Zone F.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: The hazmat cage is inside Zone F.

facts.subject: warehouse_manager
facts.value: Accountable for the whole site: operations, safety and final sign-offs.
facts.statement: The warehouse manager is accountable for the whole site: operations, safety and final sign-offs.

facts.subject: shift_supervisor
facts.value: Runs one shift: floor staff and incident response.
facts.statement: The shift supervisor runs one shift: floor staff and incident response.

facts.subject: forklift_operator
facts.value: Operates forklifts, reach trucks and pallet jacks.
facts.statement: Forklift operators operate forklifts, reach trucks and pallet jacks.

facts.subject: picker
facts.value: Picks customer orders in Zone C against scanner tasks.
facts.statement: Pickers pick customer orders in Zone C against scanner tasks.

facts.subject: inbound_operator
facts.value: Unloads, counts and inspects inbound goods in Zone A.
facts.statement: Inbound operators unload, count and inspect inbound goods in Zone A.

facts.subject: stock_controller
facts.value: Owns inventory accuracy: cycle counts, recounts and adjustments.
facts.statement: Stock controllers own inventory accuracy: cycle counts, recounts and adjustments.

facts.subject: returns_staff
facts.value: Inspects returns in Zone F and proposes restock, rework or scrap.
facts.statement: Returns staff inspect returns in Zone F and propose restock, rework or scrap.

facts.subject: maintenance_technician
facts.value: Maintains MHE, racking and dock equipment and logs all repairs.
facts.statement: The maintenance technician maintains MHE, racking and dock equipment and logs all repairs.

facts.subject: dispatcher
facts.value: Books transport, assigns dock doors and releases outbound loads.
facts.statement: Dispatchers book transport, assign dock doors and release outbound loads.

facts.subject: stocktake
facts.statement: Only the warehouse manager may sign off stocktake results.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: The shift supervisor approves damaged-goods write-offs up to 500 EUR.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: The warehouse manager approves damaged-goods write-offs above 500 EUR.

facts.subject: returns
facts.statement: The shift supervisor approves the final disposition of inspected returns.

facts.subject: overtime
facts.statement: Only the warehouse manager may approve overtime.

facts.subject: docks
facts.statement: The dispatcher assigns dock doors and time slots to carriers.

facts.subject: incidents
facts.statement: The shift supervisor reviews every incident report.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Only the warehouse manager may authorise new forklift operators.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-01 is titled Inbound receiving.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-02 is titled Put-away to storage.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-03 is titled Replenishment of pick faces.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-04 is titled Order picking.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-05 is titled Packing and labelling.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-06 is titled Outbound dispatch.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-07 is titled Returns handling.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-08 is titled Stocktaking and cycle counts.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-09 is titled Damaged-goods handling.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-10 is titled Forklift and MHE operation.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-11 is titled Pedestrian safety in the warehouse.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-12 is titled Cold-chain handling.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-13 is titled Hazmat handling and spill response.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-14 is titled Emergency evacuation.

facts.subject: procedure
facts.statement: Procedure PR-15 is titled End-of-shift handover.

facts.subject: ppe
facts.statement: High-visibility vests are mandatory for everyone on the warehouse floor.

facts.subject: ppe
facts.statement: Safety footwear class S3 is mandatory on the warehouse floor.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Forklift operators must wear seat belts whenever the truck is moving.

facts.subject: receiving
facts.statement: At receiving, the document check happens BEFORE unloading (PR-01).

facts.subject: receiving
facts.statement: Inbound goods are inspected BEFORE they are booked into the system (PR-01).

facts.subject: putaway
facts.statement: Goods are booked into the system BEFORE put-away to storage (PR-02).

facts.subject: picking
facts.statement: Pick faces are replenished BEFORE the picking shift starts (PR-03).

facts.subject: packing
facts.statement: Picked items are scan-verified BEFORE packing (PR-04, PR-05).

facts.subject: returns
facts.statement: Returns are inspected BEFORE any restock, rework or scrap decision (PR-07).

facts.subject: stocktaking
facts.statement: A second count happens BEFORE any stock adjustment is posted (PR-08).

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: The daily forklift check happens BEFORE first use each day (PR-10).

facts.subject: evacuation
facts.statement: Roll call at the assembly point happens BEFORE anyone re-enters the building (PR-14).

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: The fleet has 6 electric counterbalance forklifts.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Counterbalance forklifts are rated at 2.5 t.

facts.subject: reach_truck
facts.statement: The fleet has 4 reach trucks for the high bays.

facts.subject: reach_truck
facts.statement: Reach trucks are rated at 1.6 t.

facts.subject: pallet_jack
facts.statement: The fleet has 8 electric pallet jacks.

facts.subject: pallet_jack
facts.statement: The site has 12 hand pallet jacks.

facts.subject: wrapper
facts.statement: Dispatch uses 2 semi-automatic stretch wrappers.

facts.subject: baler
facts.statement: The site has 1 cardboard baler.

facts.subject: dock
facts.statement: Each of the 8 dock doors has a dock leveller.

facts.subject: scanner
facts.statement: Pickers and inbound staff share 20 handheld WMS scanners.

facts.subject: shift_1
facts.statement: Shift 1 runs 06:00-14:00, Monday to Friday.

facts.subject: shift_2
facts.statement: Shift 2 runs 14:00-22:00, Monday to Friday.

facts.subject: cycle_count
facts.statement: Cycle counts run every working day on a rotating zone schedule.

facts.subject: stocktake
facts.statement: A full wall-to-wall stocktake runs once a year.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Every forklift gets a documented pre-use check each day.

facts.subject: racking
facts.statement: Racking gets a documented safety inspection every month.

facts.subject: evacuation
facts.statement: An evacuation drill runs every quarter.

facts.subject: returns
facts.statement: Returns are accepted within 14 days of delivery.

facts.subject: cold_zone
facts.statement: Cold-zone temperature is manually verified each shift.

facts.subject: pallet
facts.statement: A pallet, including its load, may weigh at most 1000 kg.

facts.subject: trailer
facts.statement: Our contracted curtain-side trailers carry a payload of 24000 kg.

facts.subject: trailer
facts.statement: A trailer has 33 floor pallet positions.

facts.subject: van
facts.statement: Our delivery van carries a payload of 1200 kg.

facts.subject: van
facts.statement: The delivery van has 6 pallet positions.

facts.subject: outbound_door
facts.statement: Each outbound door handles 3 trailer loads per shift.

facts.subject: docks
facts.statement: There are 4 outbound dock doors.

facts.subject: trailer
facts.statement: A trailer takes at most 24 full-weight pallets (payload divided by maximum pallet weight, capped by floor positions).

facts.subject: van
facts.statement: The van takes at most 1 full-weight pallets; heavier orders go by trailer.

facts.subject: dispatch
facts.statement: Outbound capacity is at most 288 full-weight pallets per shift (doors x loads per shift x pallets per trailer).

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: The hazmat cage holds at most 4 full-weight pallets (hazmat stock limit divided by maximum pallet weight).

facts.subject: rework_area
facts.statement: The rework area is located in Zone F.

facts.subject: floor_staff
facts.statement: Floor staff must stay in assigned zones and tasks unless reassigned by the shift supervisor.

facts.subject: overtime_period
facts.statement: Every approved overtime period must be covered by a responsible supervisor.

facts.subject: building
facts.value: closed unless overtime approved and supervised
facts.statement: Outside staffed shifts the building remains closed unless overtime working has been expressly approved and supervised.

facts.subject: inbound_exception
facts.statement: The shift supervisor must be notified immediately of inbound quantity variances, damage or missing documents.

facts.subject: pallet_labelling
facts.statement: Pallet labels are printed or activated at booking in Zone A and each pallet carries its identifier before leaving Zone A.

facts.subject: inbound_staging
facts.statement: Booked inbound pallets are staged in Zone A by destination before put-away collection.

facts.subject: rack_position
facts.statement: Each rack position in Zone B may hold only one pallet identifier.

facts.subject: putaway
facts.statement: Rack put-away booking must be confirmed with the WMS scanner before leaving the bay.

facts.subject: overload_consignment
facts.statement: A consignment that would overload a single rack bay must be split across two or more bays in the same aisle.

facts.subject: free_block_stack
facts.statement: Free block stacking in Zone B is only allowed in marked floor areas outside the racking and never inside storage aisles.

facts.subject: bay_utilisation
facts.statement: Stock controllers are responsible for monitoring bay utilisation and reporting overloads or damage.

facts.subject: unstable_stack
facts.statement: Leaning stacks, broken boards or shifted loads must be reported to the shift supervisor.

facts.subject: hazmat_goods
facts.statement: All classified hazardous goods must be stored only inside the fenced hazmat cage.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: Damaged units found during storage or returns inspection must be transferred to quarantine.

facts.subject: quarantine
facts.value: inspection, approval and system clearance, then release
facts.statement: Quarantine release happens only after inspection, approval and system clearance.

facts.subject: pick_face
facts.statement: Each pick face holds a single SKU facing the operator aisle.

facts.subject: picking
facts.statement: Each pick must scan the location label and then the unit label before placing goods into the order container.

facts.subject: flow_lane
facts.statement: Flow lanes are loaded from the rear replenishment side and picked from the front operator side.

facts.subject: empty_pallets_waste
facts.statement: Empty pallets and waste in Zone C must be staged only at the marked collection points.

facts.subject: replenishment
facts.statement: Stock controllers trigger replenishment from inventory accuracy data.

facts.subject: replenishment_shortage
facts.statement: Shortages, damage or misplaced reserve pallets during replenishment must be reported to the shift supervisor without delay.

facts.subject: replenishment
facts.value: bulk pallet scan, then destination pick face scan
facts.statement: During replenishment the bulk pallet is scanned before the destination pick face is scanned.

facts.subject: scanner
facts.statement: Damaged, low-battery, unreadable-display and end-of-shift handheld WMS scanners must be returned to and stored in the charging station/charger.

facts.subject: packing
facts.value: Packing and labelling, then Outbound dispatch
facts.statement: Packing and labelling (PR-05) must be executed for every order container before release to outbound dispatch (PR-06).

facts.subject: wrapping
facts.statement: Every outbound pallet must be wrapped to base-to-top stability before staging for collection.

facts.subject: dock_restraint
facts.value: place restraint or wheel chock, then open trailer doors
facts.statement: The dock restraint or wheel chock must be placed before opening the trailer doors.

facts.subject: trailer_loading
facts.value: inspect trailer condition, then start loading
facts.statement: Trailer condition must be checked before loading starts.

facts.subject: trailer_departure
facts.value: reconcile loaded quantity, then close doors
facts.statement: Loaded quantity must be reconciled with release documentation before closing the trailer doors.

facts.subject: trailer_rejection
facts.statement: Rejected contaminated, damaged or unsafe trailers must be notified to the dispatcher for replacement booking.

facts.subject: outbound_load
facts.value: assess before wrapping and staging, check at wrapping, verify at staging, re-confirm before departure
facts.statement: Outbound pallet weights must be assessed before wrapping and staging, checked at wrapping, verified at staging, and re-confirmed before truck departure.

facts.subject: door_out_of_service
facts.statement: If an outbound door is taken out of service, the dispatcher must be notified immediately.

facts.subject: labour_shortfall
facts.statement: Any labour shortfall affecting outbound loading must be reported to the dispatcher immediately.

facts.subject: cycle_count
facts.statement: Cycle counts must count from physical stock first and then compare with the system figure.

facts.subject: recount
facts.statement: Recounts for locations with a variance must be assigned to a different counter where staffing allows.

facts.subject: counted_location
facts.statement: Moves for a location under active count may resume only after the counter releases the location.

facts.subject: stocktake
facts.statement: All inbound, outbound, replenishment and internal moves must be frozen before stocktake counting starts.

facts.subject: stocktake
facts.value: warehouse manager sign-off, then post adjustments
facts.statement: Approved wall-to-wall stock adjustments must be posted only after warehouse manager sign-off has been recorded.

facts.subject: stocktake
facts.value: sign-off and posting, then resume normal work
facts.statement: The site may be released back to normal work only after stocktake sign-off and posting of all adjustments.

facts.subject: adjusted_location
facts.value: second physical check before task close
facts.statement: Any adjusted rack location must be reconfirmed by a second physical check before closing the task.

facts.subject: out_of_service_bay
facts.statement: A bay marked out of service must not be reused until the repair log confirms its release.

facts.subject: returns_receipt
facts.statement: Returns receipt takes place in Zone F.

facts.subject: returns_unloading
facts.value: delivery note, return authorisation and reason before unloading
facts.statement: Delivery note, return authorisation and reason for return must be obtained before unloading returns.

facts.subject: restock
facts.value: Zone B, Zone C, Zone E
facts.statement: Approved restock must be booked back to its Zone B, Zone C or Zone E location.

facts.subject: rework
facts.statement: Approved rework units must return to inspection on completion before any restock booking.

facts.subject: scrap_valuation
facts.statement: Every scrap and damaged-goods proposal must be valued in EUR at cost price before seeking write-off approval.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: Damaged units must be transferred to quarantine on the same shift they are discovered.

facts.subject: quarantine_movement
facts.statement: Quarantine movement must be entered in the system immediately after the physical transfer.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: Damage must be photographed before any repacking or sorting.

facts.subject: salvage_separation
facts.statement: Separation of intact inner units from destroyed outer packaging must be done only inside Zone F.

facts.subject: quarantine
facts.statement: Quarantine holdings must be reviewed each working day.

facts.subject: dock_equipment
facts.value: inspect leveller, seal and restraint before positioning equipment
facts.statement: The leveller, dock seal and restraint must be inspected before positioning handling equipment at the door.

facts.subject: outbound_pallet
facts.statement: Film containment at base, corners and top layer must be confirmed before releasing a wrapped pallet to the dock.

facts.subject: evacuation
facts.statement: The on-duty shift supervisor is in charge of evacuation, controlling movement, accounting for staff and liaising with emergency services.

facts.subject: incident_report
facts.statement: Every incident report must be completed before the end of the shift in which the event occurred.

facts.subject: rack_repair
facts.statement: Affected rack levels must be unloaded before any repair attempt.

facts.subject: structural_damage
facts.value: photograph, then move stock or repair
facts.statement: Structural rack damage must be photographed before moving stock or starting repairs.

facts.subject: overloaded_bay
facts.statement: Any overloaded rack bay must be marked out of service immediately until the load is corrected.

facts.subject: chilled_pallets
facts.statement: Chilled pallets must not be staged outside Zone E except for immediate loading or put-away under active control.

facts.subject: temperature_abuse_pallet
facts.value: isolate and escalate before further movement
facts.statement: Any pallet showing temperature abuse must be isolated and escalated under PR-12 before any further movement.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: Hazmat cage stock weight must be checked before every put-away and any receipt exceeding 4000 kg rejected.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: Hazmat cage containers, bunds, labels and extinguishers must be inspected each shift.

facts.subject: incompatible_hazmat_classes
facts.statement: Incompatible hazmat classes must be kept segregated within the hazmat cage.

facts.subject: handover
facts.statement: PR-15 end-of-shift handover must be executed at every change of shift without exception.

facts.subject: handover
facts.statement: The outgoing shift supervisor owns the handover and remains accountable until the incoming shift supervisor has accepted the floor in person.

facts.subject: shift_log
facts.statement: Both the outgoing and incoming supervisors must sign the shift log handover entry to confirm transfer.

facts.subject: handover
facts.statement: The supervisor-to-supervisor exchange must happen before briefing the incoming floor staff.

facts.subject: outgoing_team
facts.statement: The outgoing team may be released only after the incoming shift supervisor confirms readiness to assume control.

facts.subject: safety_event
facts.statement: Any injury, near miss, racking or equipment damage, spill, fire alarm or unsafe behaviour must be notified to the shift supervisor immediately.

facts.subject: hazmat_container
facts.statement: Hazmat containers must be inspected for leaks, damage and correct labelling before put-away.

facts.subject: hazmat_container
facts.statement: Hazmat container labels must face outward for identification during checks.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.value: nothing against fencing, doors or safety equipment
facts.statement: Nothing may be stacked against hazmat cage fencing, doors or safety equipment.

facts.subject: damaged_goods_assessment
facts.statement: Damaged-goods inspection, sorting, repacking assessment, photography and valuation must be carried out only inside the quarantine area in Zone F.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: Damaged-goods write-off approval must be obtained before posting any adjustment in the system.

facts.subject: safety_review
facts.statement: Overdue safety follow-up actions are reviewed at a weekly safety review.

facts.subject: drill_debrief
facts.statement: Every evacuation drill is debriefed immediately at the assembly point.

facts.subject: evacuation
facts.statement: Only the on-duty shift supervisor may confirm the building is safe and release personnel to re-enter after an evacuation.

facts.subject: putaway
facts.statement: Put-away moves transfer pallets from Zone A to Zone B.

facts.subject: replenishment
facts.statement: Replenishment moves transfer pallets from bulk storage to Zone C.

facts.subject: picking_issues
facts.statement: Picking scanner faults, damaged labels, empty locations and quantity variances must be reported to the floor lead immediately.

facts.subject: packing
facts.statement: Packing staff execute PR-05 packing and labelling for every order container before release toward dispatch.

facts.subject: packing
facts.value: verify by scan, select carton, pack, seal, label
facts.statement: Packing benches must operate in order: verify items by scan, then select carton, then pack, then seal, then apply labels.

facts.subject: cycle_count
facts.value: Zone B, Zone C, Zone E, Zone F
facts.statement: Cycle counts are executed every working day covering Zone B, Zone C, Zone E and Zone F.

facts.subject: repair_log
facts.statement: Every maintenance intervention must be entered in the repair log on the same shift.

facts.subject: defective_forklift
facts.statement: The maintenance technician must ground any truck with a defective restraint.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: No truck with an open safety defect may enter service.

facts.subject: employee
facts.statement: Each employee reports to the shift supervisor running the shift.

facts.subject: shift_supervisor
facts.statement: The shift supervisor reports to the warehouse manager.

facts.subject: outbound_load
facts.statement: No outbound load may be released unless wrapping, documentation and dispatcher release are complete.

facts.subject: staged_loads
facts.statement: Staged loads in Zone D are released in door call order.

facts.subject: returns_logging
facts.statement: Administrators log returns receipt, inspection findings and proposed disposition in the warehouse system.

facts.subject: returns_logging
facts.statement: Returns receipt, inspection findings and proposed disposition must be logged on the day of inspection.

facts.subject: returns_confirmation
facts.statement: The client receives confirmation of acceptance, inspection result and approved disposition for returns.

facts.subject: returns_inventory_update
facts.statement: System inventory for returns is updated only after disposition approval.

facts.subject: returns_inspection
facts.statement: Returns received must be inspected in the same shift and not left unexamined across shifts.

facts.subject: returns_eligibility
facts.value: recorded delivery date to receipt of return request
facts.statement: Returns eligibility is measured from the recorded delivery date to receipt of the return request.
